epiphany-fellowship-philadelphia-pa.assessment: Epiphany Fellowship Church in Philadelphia is led by Dr. Eric Mason — founder, DTS/Gordon-Conwell educated, and author of the 2018 book "Woke Church." That book is the seminal text for introducing critical race theory, intersectionality, and social justice methodology into American evangelicalism. Eric Mason has argued that evangelicals must adopt "woke" frameworks to address racial injustice. His theological framework explicitly borrows from feminist and egalitarian methodology. Epiphany is one of the flagship churches in the woke evangelical movement, aligned with The Witness, Jude 3 Project, and similar networks. While the church affirms orthodox doctrinal basics on paper, the cultural and gender frameworks make this a BLACK-rated church under MOOP's rubric. Not recommended for Christian men seeking biblical manhood and resistance to social justice drift.
